name: NPUs and TPUs
blurb: Purpose-built accelerators outside the GPU line.

items.name: Neural Engine (M-series)
items.note: The NPU in every Apple SoC; the M4 announcement is the canonical spec source for its 38 TOPS on-device engine

items.name: Inferentia
items.note: Amazon's inference-side accelerator, the serving counterpart to Trainium

items.name: Trainium
items.note: Amazon's training chip; Trainium2 UltraServers underpin Anthropic's Project Rainier build-out

items.name: WSE-3
items.note: Wafer-scale engine: one 46,000mm2 die instead of a GPU cluster; 4 trillion transistors

items.name: TPU (Cloud TPU)
items.note: Google's in-house tensor processor family, from Trillium (v6e) onward; trains and serves Gemini and is rentable via Google Cloud

items.name: LPU
items.note: Deterministic single-core-style inference processor; the speed behind the Groq API tracked in the API directory

items.name: Maia 100
items.note: Azure's first in-house AI accelerator, announced with the Cobalt CPU for first-party workloads
